Clerk of Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re: 

Briefing Schedule in No. 17-1104, Air and Liquid Systems Corp., et al., v. 
DeVries, et al. 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent Petitioners in Air and Liquid Systems Corp., et al. v. DeVries, et al., in which 
the Court granted certiorari on Monday.  I am writing to respectfully request that the Court adopt 
a briefing schedule that makes Petitioners’ opening brief due July 9, Respondents’ brief due 
August 20, and Petitioners’ reply due September 19.  Rich Myers, counsel for Respondents, has 
agreed to this proposed schedule, which accommodates both his commitments and mine, and 
which will allow the case to be fully briefed before the start of the Term.   

Without any change to the briefing schedule, Petitioners’ brief would be due June 28, 

Respondents’ would be due July 30, and Petitioners’ reply would be due on August 29.  

Sincerely, 

s/ Shay Dvoretzky 
Shay Dvoretzky
